_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in the Panic band with no confirmed breaker in funding, stablecoin growth, or ETF flows to justify a directional call, and the 97% coil base rate makes HOLD the skilled graded call that wins when the score holds.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative implies UP toward accumulation/mean-reversion but does not explicitly call a direction, creating an implicit disagreement on forward bias
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 with BTC 30-day momentum holding above 50 and funding cooling below 45
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay below 15 with VIX spiking above 75 and funding rising above 60, forcing a deeper Panic leg down
